correctness.rationale: Gómez–Petite use the opposite assignment of 0 and 1 away from the exceptional site. The explicit c is equivalent to their system by global bit complement, not literally the same labeled language; complementation is a bijection on fixed-window patterns, which is all the numerical claim requires. For any window with sides at most 2^K, a translation residue fixes all bits except a possible jointly divisible site; lifting the translate can set that site's minimum valuation to K or K+1 at a nonsingular point. Hence both assignments at the origin generate the same language, and each pattern has a nonsingular copy that recurs on a lattice coset (take a modulus larger than all valuation depths in the copy), proving uniform recurrence and minimality of the hull. Decimation restricts to the jointly even parity class, complements the smaller pattern and forces zero elsewhere. If both exponents are at least two, the smaller pattern has a zero, so the lifted one identifies the active class and the factor of four is exact. The 2×2 base consists of an all-zero pattern and four singleton ones. On the 2×2^k base for k≥2 the active row has a one of valuation exactly one, and its capped valuation words split by parity: either a full active half for cap 1 or the complement of a shorter capped word for larger caps. From the six words at length four, the count doubles after adding one to the previous count, giving 2^(k+1)−2 words and twice this many two-row patterns. Iteration gives the exact formulas. Next-dyadic square containment and the linear square count imply zero entropy. Normalized counts depend only on |n−m|, so the fixed integer gaps and gaps tending to infinity give exactly the stated subsequential limits. A fresh bounded enumeration over strictly positive integral translates with shifts up to 4·2^max(n,m) matched all 16 pairs n,m≤4 (rows start 5,12,28,60 and diagonal is 5,20,80,320). The frozen checker was inspected but not executed.
residual_risks: The verified equivalence to the source uses a global alphabet exchange; one should not infer literal equality of labeled patch sets. No formula for general non-dyadic rectangles follows from the check.

value.rationale: An explicit zero-entropy minimal system admits an exact complexity invariant whose area normalization retains window shape. The leading constant 5/4 on squares and the discrete family converging to 2 off the diagonal cannot be read from entropy or the fundamental-domain upper bound. The same proof gives the full dyadic rectangular shape spectrum, not a small-window census.
residual_risks: The shape spectrum established is specifically dyadic and supplies a counterexample to shape-independent normalization, not a universal law for Toeplitz systems.
